passages.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is good.
The LORD shows loving devotion.
His loving devotion lasts forever.
Give thanks to the LORD.
passages.original: הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD redeems people.
The LORD saves people from their enemies.
The LORD gathers His redeemed people from many lands.
He brings them from the east.
He brings them from the west.
He brings them from the north.
He brings them from the south.
Let the redeemed of the LORD say this.
passages.original: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־ צָֽר׃ וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃

passages.text: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
passages.sermon:
Some people wandered in the desert.
They walked in dry and empty places.
They could not find a road.
They did not find a city where they could live.
passages.original: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
passages.sermon:
Some people wandered in desert wastelands.
They could not find a city to live in.
These people felt hungry.
They also felt thirsty.
Their souls grew weak inside them.
passages.original: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־ צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃

passages.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
passages.sermon:
Some people wandered in desert wastelands.
They found no path to a city where they could live.
They were hungry.
They were thirsty.
Their soul grew weak inside them.
They cried out to the LORD when they were in trouble.
The LORD heard them.
He delivered them from their distress.
passages.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃

passages.text: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
passages.sermon:
God saw the people.
The people were hungry and thirsty.
Their souls grew weak inside them.
God acted with kindness.
God led the people.
He showed them a straight path.
The path was clear and direct.
God guided them to a city.
The city was a place where they could live.
passages.original: וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־ עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃

passages.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
passages.sermon:
The LORD shows loving devotion.
The LORD does wonderful things for people.
Let people give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion.
Let people give thanks to the LORD for His wonderful works.
passages.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
passages.sermon:
God acts with loving devotion.
God satisfies people who are thirsty.
God fills people who are hungry.
God gives them good things.
passages.original: כִּי־ הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains, because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
passages.sermon:
Some people sat in darkness.
They sat in the shadow of death.
They were prisoners.
They suffered affliction.
They wore chains.
They became prisoners because they rebelled against the words of God.
They despised the counsel of the Most High.
passages.original: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃ כִּֽי־ הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־ אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃

passages.text: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
passages.sermon:
God humbled their hearts.
He used hard labor to do this.
They stumbled.
No one helped them.
passages.original: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃

passages.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
passages.sermon:
Some people suffered.
They were in trouble.
They cried out to the LORD.
They asked for help.
The LORD heard them.
He saved them from their distress.
passages.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

passages.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power and mercy.
He brought the people out of darkness.
He rescued them from the shadow of death.
He broke their chains.
He set them free.
passages.original: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃

passages.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
passages.sermon: The LORD shows loving devotion.\r\nThe LORD does wonderful things for people.\r\nLet them give thanks to the LORD.
passages.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God broke down the gates made of bronze.
God cut through the bars made of iron.
God removed every strong barrier.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃

passages.text: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
passages.sermon:
Fools act in rebellious ways.
Fools commit many sins.
Fools suffer because of their sins.
Fools experience affliction as a result of their rebellion.
passages.original: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲוֺֽנֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃

passages.text: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
passages.sermon:
These people suffered because of their sins.
They hated all food.
They refused to eat.
They became very weak.
They came close to dying.
They almost reached the gates of death.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד־ שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃

passages.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
passages.sermon:
Fools suffered because they rebelled against God.
They did evil things.
They became sick and weak.
They hated all food.
They came close to death.
Then they cried out to the LORD.
They were in trouble.
The LORD heard them.
He saved them from their distress.
passages.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

passages.text: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power and mercy.
God sent out His word.
His word brought healing to them.
God rescued them from destruction.
God saved them from the Pit.
passages.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִֽ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָֽם׃׆

passages.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
passages.sermon:
The LORD shows loving devotion.
The LORD performs wonders for people.
Let people give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion.
Let people give thanks to the LORD for His wonders to humanity.
passages.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃׆

passages.text: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
passages.sermon: The people should offer sacrifices of thanksgiving to the LORD.\r\nThey should declare the works of the LORD with rejoicing.
passages.original: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִֽיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃׆

passages.text: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
passages.sermon:
Some people travel on the sea.
They go in ships.
They work on the water.
They do business in the deep waters.
passages.original: יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בָּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃׆

passages.text: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
passages.sermon:
Sailors went out to sea in ships.
They worked on the mighty waters.
These sailors saw the works of the LORD.
They saw His wonders in the deep sea.
passages.original: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃׆

passages.text: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
passages.sermon:
God controls the sea.
God spoke.
God sent a strong storm.
The storm lifted the waves high.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃׆

passages.text: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
passages.sermon:
The people saw the works of the LORD.
They saw His wonders in the deep sea.
The waves rose high toward the sky.
The waves sank down into the deep waters.
Their courage melted away because they were afraid.
They felt anguish and lost all strength.
passages.original: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃

passages.text: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
passages.sermon:
The people faced a violent storm at sea.
They could not stand steady.
They reeled.
They staggered.
They moved like drunk people.
Their wisdom did not help them.
Their skill became useless.
passages.original: יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכָל־ חָ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃

passages.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
passages.sermon:
The people were in trouble.
They cried out to the LORD.
The LORD heard them.
He brought them out of their distress.
passages.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצֽוּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃

passages.text: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God calmed the storm.
The storm became quiet.
The waves of the sea stopped making noise.
The sea became still.
passages.original: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
passages.sermon: The people felt great joy when the sea became quiet.\r\nGod led the people to the harbor they wanted.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־ יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־ מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃

passages.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
passages.sermon:
The LORD shows loving devotion.
The LORD performs wonders for people.
Let people give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion.
Let people give thanks to the LORD for His wonders.
passages.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
passages.sermon:
The people gather together in an assembly.
They exalt the LORD there.
The elders meet in their council.
They praise the LORD in that place.
passages.original: וִֽ֭ירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־ עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃

passages.text: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground, and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts with power and authority.
He changes rivers into deserts.
He makes springs of water become dry ground.
He turns fruitful land into salty wasteland.
He does this because the people living there are wicked.
passages.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God changes the land.
God turns a desert into pools of water.
God makes dry land become flowing springs.
passages.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽאֲגַם־ מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and mercy.
God finds people who are hungry.
God brings these hungry people to a new place.
God causes the hungry people to settle in this place.
The hungry people build a city there.
The people live in this city.
passages.original: וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃

passages.text: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
passages.sermon: The people sow fields.\r\nThe people plant vineyards.\r\nThe fields and vineyards produce a fruitful harvest.
passages.original: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבֽוּאָה׃

passages.text: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
passages.sermon:
God blesses the people.
The people increase greatly.
God does not let their herds become fewer.
Their animals remain many.
passages.original: וַיְבָרֲכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃

passages.text: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow, He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and justice.
He causes some people to become few in number.
He humbles them.
Oppression, evil, and sorrow bring them low.
God pours out contempt on the nobles.
He makes the nobles wander.
They wander in a wasteland with no path.
passages.original: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃׆ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־ נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־ דָֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and mercy.
God lifts the needy out of their suffering.
God rescues them from affliction.
God gives them families.
God makes their families grow large, like flocks of sheep.
passages.original: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
passages.sermon:
The upright are people who do what is right.
The upright see what God has done.
The upright rejoice.
All iniquity is every kind of evil or wrongdoing.
All iniquity becomes silent.
All iniquity shuts its mouth.
passages.original: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכָל־ עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
A wise person listens to these things.
A wise person pays attention to these things.
A wise person thinks about the LORD’s loving devotion.
A wise person considers the LORD’s faithful love.
passages.original: מִי־ חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמָר־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
